_what_this_is: OWNER OVERRIDE SLOT, currently EMPTY. The publish order is the ranking; there is no hand-picked head. Four episodes were pinned on 2026-08-30 from opportunity data gathered before the combined score existed. Once demand was measured, two scored below episodes further down the queue and the owner removed the pin ("why the fuck are we not doing the top 4 by score"), recorded in docs/CHANNEL-PLAN.md. Leave `pinned` empty unless the owner directs a new pin.
_how_it_expires: An entry falls out of the pinned head automatically once its slug appears in research/published.json. When all four have been published the head is empty and the queue becomes purely score-ranked. No code change is needed.
_contract: Ordered list. Each entry names a query that must match an episode question extracted from scripts/*.md. A pinned query that matches no script is reported as an error, never silently dropped.
